titulo_es: Expression of a persistent desire with

bloques.titulo: The Committee expresses an intense and lasting feeling or desire towards something or someone.
texto: It is used with a limited set of verbs and usually has a written or formal tone, such as the), the) or the).
(I deeply hope that the lives of the people concerned will return to normal as soon as possible.)
I look forward to the future achievements of young researchers.

frases.ja: 被災 した 人々 の 生活 が 一日 も 早く 戻る こと を 願って やみません。
frases.es: Deseo profundamente que la vida de las personas afectadas vuelva a la normalidad cuanto antes.
frases.en: I deeply hope that the lives of the people concerned will return to normal as soon as possible.

frases.ja: 若い 研究者 の 今後 の 活躍 を 期待 して やみません。
frases.es: Espero con gran ilusión los futuros logros de los jóvenes investigadores.
frases.en: I look forward to the future achievements of young researchers.
